firstResponse: I'll investigate how autosave works for chats in this extension, focusing on the Claude Code provider path since that's what's not working.
lastResponse: The fix produces `e--chat-commit`, matching the real directory. The earlier mismatch was just shell backslash mangling. ## Summary Autosave wasn't working for Claude Code chats because the extension was watching the wrong directory. **Root cause:** [deriveClaudeCodeProjectSlug](src/claudeCodeSessionReader.ts#L322) computed the transcript directory name as `e-chat-commit` (single dash), but Claude Code actually stores transcripts in `e--chat-commit` (double dash) — confirmed: 5 active `.jsonl` transcripts there, updated today, in `C:\Users\<user>\.claude\projects\e--chat-commit\`. The autosave watcher pointed at a non-existent path, so it never detected new chats. This was a **regression from commit `0ed4ad8` ("improve project slug derivation", yesterday)**. The original code `replace(/[:\\/]/g, '-')` was correct, but the rewrite added drive-letter special-casing plus dash-collapsing (`.…
